segments.text: And then I see media every day championing the safe and effective.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: The amount of times I heard safe and effective from this prior panel that was before me is absolutely disgusting because I just had to listen to someone from a public health agency present a paper, a review paper saying that they could only find a sore arm and a little muscle pain with meningococcal vaccine.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: Even in the inserts, they describe, you know, high incidence of severe life altering illnesses.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: We know of major adverse events around this, and she's literally going to come here and testify before you that all they have to worry about is a sore arm for disease in Wisconsin, where literally six cases in 2016, four in 2017, only one from the strain that that vaccine addresses.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: So you're going to tell me we're going to force mandate against hundreds of thousands of kids to go after that one kid who died with a strain.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: And in order for that to make any sense, you'd have to believe what that doctor or person believes.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: You'd have to believe that its safety is so unparalleled that there's nothing to see here.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: This is good, sound medical judgment.
